notes: Form 10 Information Statement (Ex.99.1, 10-12B/A filed 2022-03-17) now used: audited combined (carve-out) statements FY2019-FY2021 of the 'Fabrication Technology Business of Colfax Corporation', summary historical data (covers 2019-2021 only), MD&A and notes. The Form 10 has no EPS for historical periods (pro forma 2021 only) and no interim (2021 quarterly / Sep-2021) statements.

Pre-spin carve-out (combined) presentation: ESAB was the Fabrication Technology business of Colfax/Enovis until the April 4, 2022 Separation. Asbestos-holding entities, certain pension plans and debt were contributed at Separation and are NOT in 2019-2021 statements (10-K Note 1).
EPS for pre-spin periods computed by the company on 60,034,311 shares (shares distributed at Separation); basic = diluted. No dividends declared pre-spin (dps_declared=0).

BS: prepaid_other_current = Prepaid expenses 51,949 + Other current assets 67,357 (sum derived). current_debt, other_current_liabilities, long_term_debt = 0 (no such lines / '—'). Asbestos: 10-K Note 13 shows asbestos liability '—' at Dec 31, 2021; asbestos entities were contributed at Separation, so asbestos assets/liabilities set 0.
shares_outstanding_period_end = 0.0001 million (100 shares per BS caption, pre-spin); use 60.034311 for per-share work.

CF: 'Loss (gain) on sale of PP&E (447)' in noncash_restructuring_impairment_gains; 'Proceeds from borrowings on revolving credit facility and other 673' in revolver_net; D&A line = 'Depreciation, amortization and other impairment charges'.

10-K: Depreciation expense 32.5M; intangible amortization expense 42.1M; US-origin net sales 533.5M. Segment D&A incl. impairment Americas 33.890, EMEA & APAC 42.009; capex 14.095 / 21.489; total assets Americas 1,304.797, EMEA & APAC 2,156.465. Mix: consumables 69% / equipment 31%.

Sales change FY2021 vs FY2020 from Form 10 MD&A (total only: existing businesses +456.6 (23.4%), acquisitions +2.1 (0.1%), FX +19.3 (1.0%), total +478.0 (24.5%)). Segment split of organic/FX not disclosed; segment total change from MD&A narrative (Americas +236.8, EMEA & APAC +241.2); segment total_pct not printed. Organic drivers: volume ~152, inflation pricing ~214, new products ~90 (approx.).

FORM 10 vs 10-K (FY2021): IS, BS and CF amounts identical line-by-line (labels differ: Form 10 'Pension settlement (gain) loss', 'Interest (income) expense and other, net', 'Net income attributable to Fabrication Technology Business of Colfax Corporation', BS 'Net Parent investment'/'Total Parent's equity', CF 'Proceeds from short-term borrowings 673', 'Transfers to Parent, net'). Form 10 combined IS has no discontinued-ops or EPS lines; 10-K adds EPS 3.92 on 60,034,311 shares.

FORM 10 segment data (FY2021): segment measure = segment operating income (OI before restructuring): Americas 119,737 / EMEA & APAC 205,431 / Total 325,168 thousand; MD&A GAAP OI by segment Americas 108.1 / EMEA & APAC 198.1 (vs 10-K/Q4-2022 release recast 111.2 / 195.0); Adjusted EBITA 141.5 / 224.2 / 365.7; segment SG&A 222.7 / 290.1 (10-K: 219.6 / 293.2); segment gross profit 342.5 / 495.5. Pro forma BS (Form 10) adds 30,572 accrued / 261,779 other liabilities for asbestos.
